testTemplates.S01: Valid DSL -> MathDocument -> OMML -> DSL; compare explicit presence, values and untouched subtree semantics.
testTemplates.S02: For each legal parent: order, choice, min/max occurrence, missing/duplicate child, namespace and input budgets.
testTemplates.S03: Absent/empty-if-allowed/explicit-default/nondefault/off-if-switch; units, boundary and invalid values; conflicts adjudicated by M15.
testTemplates.S04: Real rendered geometry and ink bounds using an independent font/standard oracle; SVG/PDF and editing hit map.
testTemplates.S05: Native exact-node edit, undo/redo, cancel, save, process restart and stale-revision rejection.
testTemplates.S06: Actual Word open/edit/save/reopen and ReadMD reimport; SDK-only validation is insufficient.
testTemplates.S07: MathML/EPUB actual independent-reader projection; identify standard limitations and report semantic losses.
testTemplates.S08: Inherited abstract-type constraints verified through concrete descendants; no user insertable abstract object.
testTemplates.S09: Every enumeration facet compiles/decompiles and is consumed in the intended parent, with invalid alternatives rejected.
